messages:
Elena P.: hi team, started this morning! quick orientation Qs: who owns monorepo write perms, who to contact for dedicated inference queue credentials, and who signs off on private model pulls for customer data? trying to batch my requests for day 1 :wave:
Maya (DevEx): welcome Elena!! :tada: short map — repo perms: people-ops (Taylor) handles role assignments; dedicated queue & GPU creds: eng-platform (Rohit); private model pulls & compliance: security (Lina) + legal. full checklist is at https://intranet.redwood.com/onboarding/day1 (look under "access owners").
Rohit (Platform): for the dedicated queue, please open a request with this payload so we can size and assign creds quickly:
```
service: <service-name>
team: <team-name>
workload_profile:
  qps: <expected>
  seq_len: <avg/token>
  batch_size: <batch>
start_date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
reason: <short justification>
```
include whether you need persistent volumes for cache or long-running jobs. tag @eng-platform in the ticket so we pick it up.
Lina (Security): private model pulls = security review + data-flow diagram. if the model touches customer data we need a DPA check and a signed access policy. typical SLA is 48h for review; mark the ticket P1 if you need expedited review.
Taylor (People Ops): repo perms — please cc your manager and list any CI service accounts that need access. for the monorepo we grant team-level write by default; if you need cross-team perms we do an exception request. I'll watch for your ticket.
Simon SRE: infra escalation summary: for capacity/latency issues page @eng-oncall immediately (pager). For access delays: owner -> team lead (2h) -> eng-oncall (4h) -> head-infra (8h). For production incidents always page oncall first, don't wait. :warning:
Ops-bot: Elena P. added to #new-hires, onboarding checklist assigned to Maya (DevEx), and read access granted to the engineering wiki.
Elena P.: super helpful, thank you! last q — if a ticket is stalled for >3h who do I escalate to directly?
Maya (DevEx): escalate to the team lead listed on the ticket first. if it's infra-related and still stalled after 2h, add @eng-oncall and tag `onboarding-urgent`. that flag surfaces the ticket in our triage tool.
Elena P.: perfect — opening the three requests now and will paste the templates. thanks everyone :pray:
